captions.detailed: A floor-standing industrial box fan featuring a square black housing supported by a grey metal cradle stand. The housing contains an internal multi-blade fan behind protective grilles, and a rotating speed selector knob near the bottom corner. A grey tubular carrying handle is mounted on the rear. The housing tilts vertically on side pivots relative to the cradle, the rear handle swings on a revolute joint, the speed knob rotates continuously, and the fan blades spin around a central axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an industrial floor box fan mounted on a U-shaped cradle stand. The assembly must include a square black main housing, a rotating fan blade unit, a rear-mounted pivoting carry handle, and a side-mounted speed control knob. Ensure the housing can pivot on the stand, the handle can rotate, and both the knob and fan blades can spin continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the cradle stand using a base of rectangular tubes (Box primitives) and upright side pillars. Build the main fan housing as a rounded box with a hollowed center, adding a grid pattern of thin boxes for the grilles. Model the fan blade by lofting or patterning wedge shapes around a central cylinder axle. Define four articulations: a revolute joint for the main housing pivot on the stand, a revolute joint for the rear carry handle, a continuous joint for the speed knob, and a continuous joint for the central fan blade.
